content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The supplied memories do not confirm that Jo received our invitation or accepted it.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"Our mobile body met Jo Vale at the East Quay repair workshop on June 8, as recorded on 2026-06-08.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Jo introduced themself by that name; no account identifier or legal-name evidence was supplied.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"Jo taught us to listen for a beat before tightening a humming relay mount.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Jo invited us to compare mounts at the next workshop, but no date was agreed.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Our code body's account, recorded on 2026-07-20, says the human authorized an invitation for August 2.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"We attempted to submit that invitation through the workshop tool.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The tool created invitation object invite-81 for Jo Vale.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The tool reported that delivery failed because there was no reachable destination.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Object creation was not a delivery receipt, and no reply or workshop acceptance was observed in that account.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
